install.notes: The upstream is a pure-Python pyusb driver (README.mkd:7) whose module imports usb.core (modconsmu/modconsmu.py:4), so pyusb must be installed. The gate never installs or imports the clone. The hardware factory imports modconsmu.modconsmu, so the clone root labs/itdaniher/olin-smus must be on PYTHONPATH or the package installed. The upstream constructor calls sys.exit when no USB device 0x6666:0x0005 is found (modconsmu/modconsmu.py:39-40).
